title: A/R Collection: sorting moves rows, never groups, and keeps groups open
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Three customers, {Customer-A}, {Customer-B} and {Customer-C}, have overdue invoices on today's date; in name order they read A, B, C.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-26 Alder, {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-26 Birch and {Customer-C} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-26 Cedar.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Collection is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu; {Customer-A}'s and {Customer-C}'s groups are expanded and {Customer-B}'s is collapsed.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Open balance" header.
  2. Click the "Open balance" header again.
  3. Click the "Date" header.
  4. Look at which groups are expanded.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: rows re-sort inside each customer group, largest first; the groups keep their name order, {Customer-A}, {Customer-B}, {Customer-C}.
  • Step 2: rows re-sort smallest first; the groups keep their name order, {Customer-A}, {Customer-B}, {Customer-C}.
  • Step 3: rows re-sort by Date; the groups keep their name order, {Customer-A}, {Customer-B}, {Customer-C}.
  • Step 4: {Customer-A} and {Customer-C} are still expanded and {Customer-B} still collapsed: re-sorting never expands or collapses a group.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header), story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows)

  • S2-R5: “On the grouped reports, a header click sorts the rows inside each group; the groups themselves never move (S1-R5, S1-R6).”
  • S2-R9: “Re-sorting never changes which groups are expanded or collapsed (Story 4).”
  • S4-R8: “Re-sorting and paging keep every group's expanded or collapsed state.”
  • What changes for existing users: “Re-sorting A/R Collection or A/P Unpaid Invoices no longer collapses the open groups.”
